title: Consciousness as experience of the body from within

statements.text: Consciousness is a principal means for a living organism to experience the state of operations inside its body. It lets the organism know about itself and gives it a subjective perspective on itself and its surroundings. The account places it low in the scale of biological complexity, as part of life regulation, not at the level of cognition.
